title: Ay mere asghare
body:
ay mere asghare bezaban
tujhe dhoondne jaun kahan
tujhpe sadqe gayi teri maa
tujhe dhoondne jaun kahan
<<DIVIDER>>
saari saari raat tujhko jhoola jhula'un mai
jhoola jhula'un mai
mere tashna jigar tashna jaan
tujhe dhoondne jaun kahan
ay mere asghare...
<<DIVIDER>>
raat andheri jangal saara sayein sayein karta hai
sayein sayein karta hai
andhayr hai saara jahan
tujhe dhoondne jaun kahan
ay mere asghare...
<<DIVIDER>>
seene lagaun jhoola jhulaun doodh pilaun aajao
doodh pilaun aajao
tashnalab mere tashna dahan
tujhe dhoondne jaun kahan
ay mere asghare....
<<DIVIDER>>
sehra sehra tujhko dhoonda jangal jangal chani hoo
jangal jangal chani hoo
tera paaya na koi nashan
tujhe dhoondne jaun kahan
ay mere asghare...
<<DIVIDER>>
sunsan jangal raat andheri gor may tanha sotay ho
gor may tanha sotay ho
haye kisko mai doo loriyan
tujhe dhoondne jaun kahan
ay mere asghare...
<<DIVIDER>>
kab se teri madar dukhiya aas lagaye baithi hai
aas lagaye baithi hai
teri raah may bichayi akhiyan
tujhe dhoondne jaun kahan
ay mere asghare...
<<DIVIDER>>
banu-e-muztar karbal ban may kehti thi mirza peet ke sar
kehti thi mirza peet ke sar
tujhe dhoondne jaun kahan
tujhe dhoondne jaun kahan
ay mere asghare...
author: Mirza Murtaza Ali
